newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Paranagua port unions to meet Thu for strike vote.
newsitem.headline: Paranagua port unions to meet Thu for strike vote.

text.p: Unions at the key Brazilian port of Paranagua were to meet at 1000 local/1300 GMT Thursday to vote on whether to take part in a nationwide strike by stevedores scheduled for Friday, a union official said.
"We are going to have a meeting tomorrow with all the unions at Paranagua to define the position of Paranagua with regard to the strike," said a spokesman at the Paranagua Stevedores' Union.
An official at the Paranagua Administrative Portworkers' Union earlier said she knew of no plans by the port's workers to strike Friday.

Stevedores at Santos port started a 48-hour strike at 0700 local/100 GMT over a ruling which allows company workers from steel mill Companhia Siderurgica Paulista (Cosipa) to operate Cosipa's private terminal at the port.
The strike is scheduled to spread to the national level on Friday, the National Stevedores' Union said.
